name: Nuar Lore
text: Nuars are no strangers to wandering the stars and exploring alien worlds, meeting other nuars along the way. You possess an innate sense of location that never leaves you truly lost. You become trained in Piloting and Survival. If you're already trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Nuar Lore.

name: Nuke Form
text: With a flash of nuclear fire, you suddenly transform into a radioactive monster, gaining the effects of a 7th-rank for 1 minute. You gain immunity to radiation in this form. Creatures struck by your tendril must attempt a Fortitude save against mild radiation sickness. This radiation uses the higher of your class DC or spell DC in place of the radiation's normal Fortitude DC, has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round (but it doesn't cause glitching). Saving Throw Stage 1 ] and Sickened 1 (1 round) Stage 2 ] and Sickened 2 (1 round) Stage 3 ] and Sickened 3 (1 round)

name: Nutritionist
text: Your cilia are even more selective about the molecules they siphon for nutrients. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the soldier's tough as nails class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save, you get a failure instead.

name: Objects in Motion
text: Requirements Your last action was a successful Shove. You leverage your knowledge of energy, mass, and motion against your opponents to manipulate their battlefield positioning. The Shoved creature continues moving. They're pushed back an additional 5 feet, or 10 feet if the required Shove was a critical success. If they would collide with a solid surface due to this movement, you immediately attempt to Trip them as a free action, even if they're no longer within your reach.

name: Oddity Identification
text: Your experience with the occult gives you insight into strange phenomena. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks to Identify Magic that is unusual, aberrant, or from outside normal traditions.

name: Off the Top of My Head
text: Frequency once per day Your incredible processing power and near-perfect recall allow you to refocus even in stressful situations. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

name: Offensive Defense
text: Requirements You have a force field upgrade in your armor or are holding a tech shield. You overcharge a shield to create a concussive blast that repulses nearby foes. You Area Fire using your force field or shield, dealing 2d10[bludgeoning|options:area-damage,forced-movement] damage in a 5-foot radius burst centered on one corner of a square you occupy. This attack has the tracking +1 trait and is in the shield weapon group. A creature that fails its save is pushed back 5 feet. If you have the primary target class feature, the primary target Strike uses your force field or shield. Special If you're using a force field or shield that's superior or better, the tracking trait increases to +2, or +3 if ultimate or better. Likewise, if it's elite or better, the damage increases to 3d10[bludgeoning|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel], or 4d10[bludgeoning|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel] if paragon.

text: Nanites augment your attacks.

name: On A Roll
text: Nothing will stop you from moving forward. Each time you use an action with the move trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would impose the Fatigued, Immobilized, Paralyzed, slowed, or Suppressed conditions until the end of your next turn. When you would be fatigued, immobilized, paralyzed, slowed, or suppressed for at least 2 rounds, reduce that duration by 1 round.

name: One With the Newborn
text: You acknowledge that you are connected to the Newborn, now and forever, and have embraced the nascent godling as family. You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in this skill (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Newborn Lore. In addition, the first time each day that you gain the dying condition, the Newborn—or perhaps some other unknown force—automatically stabilizes you. You lose the dying condition, though you remain Unconscious at 0 Hit Points.

name: One with the Stone
text: You've achieved a full connection with the spirit of the rock, and the minerals meld with your body to aid you the moment you call. You can cast Enlarge once per hour as a 4th-rank primal innate spell targeting only yourself. When you do, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for as long as the spell is in effect.

name: One With the Void
text: You've become so soaked in void energies from your studies that you're empowered by them. You gain void healing until you Dismiss the effect.

name: One-Izalguun Band
text: You use your multiple limbs to play two or more instruments at the same time, creating your own melodies, counter-melodies, and harmonies to impress your audience. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat and can apply its benefits to keyboards, percussion, strings, synths, and winds.

name: Only Slightly Dead
text: Your living body is flush with vitality, which easily hides your ichor-filled veins from sight. You don't have to attempt Deception checks against a creature's Perception DC to successfully Impersonate yourself as a living member of your ancestry or hide your borai heritage, nor do you require a disguise kit for such Impersonations. This is a non-magical effect that doesn't protect against detection, revelation, or scrying effects. Additionally, when a creature actively attempts a Perception check against you, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC, but only for the purposes of seeing through your disguise when you're Impersonating yourself as a living member of your ancestry or otherwise attempting to hide your borai heritage.

name: Oozy Brains
text: Your brains are just as oozy as the rest of your "body." You can move through a gap at least 2 inches wide without Squeezing and can [[/act squeeze]] through a gap at least 1 inch wide. When you're struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage, roll a flat. On a success, the hit becomes a normal hit.

name: Opening Roar
text: At the start of a combat encounter, if you are aware of your foes and aren't attempting to Sneak or Hide", you can roll an Intimidation check for your initiative and can use the result to Demoralize one observed foe.

name: Opening Volley
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun and a melee weapon. You shoot your target, then you follow up with a melee attack to keep the pressure on your foe. Make a ranged Strike with your held gun. If the Strike is successful, your next melee attack this round against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

text: You've adopted the operative's precise, opportunistic style. You become trained in Stealth and in operative weapons; if you were already trained in Stealth, you become an expert instead. Once per round you can deal 1 additional precision damage on a strike against a flat-footed creature. Special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the operative archetype. (Prerequisite Dexterity 14 shown for reference; not enforced in-app.)

name: Operative Exploit
text: You gain the exploit of your chosen specialization.

name: Operative Resiliency
text: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each operative archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting operative archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

name: Opportune Retort

text: Trigger A creature critically fails a melee Strike against you. You seize the opportunity to give your foe a big hug to help them feel better or calm down. You attempt an Athletics check to Grapple the triggering creature. Special If you have the Titan Wrestler skill feat, you can use Opportunistic Hug against creatures up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.

name: Optimistic Failure
text: You're an eternal optimist, and you wouldn't have it any other way! No matter how close you come to failing at a task (or how often you fail), you know if you just keep trying, you're bound to succeed. You can use once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Orbital Defense
text: Trigger You take damage from an enemy or hazard. Requirements Satellites are currently orbiting you due to Pull Into Orbit. You exert precise control over the debris that's orbiting you, purposefully placing it between you and harm to shield your body. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the triggering damage. Pull into Orbit immediately ends.

name: Orc Kinship
text: The Quest for Sky caused many wars between orcs and dwarves in the past, but now, you're the only ones who can truly understand each other. You've spent time around orcs and learned from them, and you proudly count yourself among their friends. You gain the general feat and must select orc as the feat's chosen ancestry. You also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat.

name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
text: You've trained with the weapons of your people. You are trained in orc weapons such as the orc knuckle dagger and falchion, and gain their critical specialization effects.

name: Otherworldly Spell
text: Your spell has an odd appearance or cosmetic effect. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, creatures with the ability to Cast that Spell don't automatically know what the spell is. In addition, creatures that witness your spellcasting take a –2 circumstance penalty to checks to identify the spell with Recall Knowledge and checks to counteract the spell and its effects.

name: Overclock Focus
text: [reaction] (once per day) Trigger: you cast a non-cantrip spell that isn't jailbroken. Requirements: your gear is overclocked. You route the excess energy back into yourself, regaining 1 Focus Point.

name: Overclock Spell Database
text: [reaction] (once per day) Trigger: you cast a non-cantrip spell not modified by Jailbreak Spell. Requirements: your gear is overclocked. Once during the next minute you can Cast a Spell directly from your spell cache, up to the triggering spell's rank, without using a spell slot.

name: Overcome Shame
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger You critically fail a Strike against an enemy. You clear your mind of distractions and focus on your foe, determined to overcome the shame of your failure lest it forever blemish your reputation. The next time before the end of your turn that you attempt a Strike with the same weapon and target as the triggering attack, you roll the attack roll twice and use the higher result. If the attack misses, you're overwhelmed with shame, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn.

text: Your psychic abilities stimulate growth in the world around you. If the next action you use is to Cast a primal innate Spell, you make plants grow around you in a . Other creatures treat this area as difficult terrain for 1 minute.

name: Overkill
text: Sometimes there's no better way to assure success than to pin a hapless enemy with concentrated firepower. When you Suppress a creature with Area Fire or Auto-Fire and only one creature was in the area of your attack, or when you use Concentrated Shot, the target takes 1d10[persistent,bleed] damage. If you critically hit it with your primary target Strike, this increases to 2d10[persistent,bleed] damage.

text: Trigger An ally is about to use an action that requires a skill check or attack roll. You're always willing to jump in and help, even if you don't know what you're doing. You Aid a willing ally, even if you didn't prepare to help them ahead of time. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on your check to Aid, but after the triggering check, your ally becomes Clumsy 1 until the end of their current turn.

name: Overproduction
text: Frequency once per day Your cilia help you to consume slowly even as they absorb nutrients, drawing out some extra potency from alchemical items. When you consume an alchemical item that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, that item's duration is doubled.

name: Overvolt Resistor
text: [one-action] If your next action is to Cast a Spell, the spell ignores an amount of the target's resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to your level, applying to all damage including persistent and ongoing effects. Immunities are unaffected.

name: Overwatch
text: You hold an area against all comers. Spend 1 action to enter an overwatch stance. Until your next turn, you can spend your reaction to make a ranged Strike against any creature that moves within your first range increment.

name: Overwhelming Assault
text: You overwhelm the defenses of suppressed foes. Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against suppressed targets is –4 (–3 with an agile weapon) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –8 (–7 with an agile weapon) on your third and subsequent attacks of the turn instead of –10.

name: Overwhelming Assault

name: Overwhelming Ego
text: You can focus your mental Strikes with truly devastating precision. Whenever you critically hit using your psychic shock unarmed Strike, you get its critical specialization effect. The first time each round you hit an enemy you can sense with your thoughtsense using a psychic shock Strike, you deal an additional 1d4[persistent,mental] damage to your target.

name: Overwhelming Shot
text: You pierce through your foe's resistance with a well-timed shot. You Aim and then make a Strike against your mark. Select one of the following damage types: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, mental, piercing, poison, slashing, or sonic damage. Your shot ignores an amount of the target's resistance to the selected damage type equal to your level. If the creature has a weakness to the selected damage type, increase that weakness by an amount equal to half your level. A creature's immunities are unaffected.

name: Pack Empathy
text: Your empathic bonds strengthen allies. When you Aid an ally, they also gain a +1 status bonus to their next save before your next turn.

name: Pahtra Caterwaul
text: Your strange singing voice can cause a moment's reconsideration or hesitation. Attempt a Performance check against the Will DC of a target within 30 feet. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your Pahtra Caterwaul for 24 hours. Critical Success The target becomes Frightened 1 and Stupefied 1 as long as it's frightened. Success The target becomes frightened 1.

name: Pahtra Lore
text: You're an expert in both the traditional and modern pahtra performing arts. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Performance. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Pahtra Lore.

name: Paint Splash
text: Infused with primal magic, you can use your glowing pigment to dazzle your enemies in a spray of glittering paint. You can cast revealing light as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell. You can't use again until you spend 1 hour to forage for new pigments. It takes only 10 minutes to find these pigments if you're in an environment with a plethora of minerals appropriate for your paint, such as an underground cave or a vehicle paint and auto body shop.

name: Paragon Mageslayer
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger An enemy within 10 feet attempts to Cast a Spell or Activate a magic item. You emit a burst of disruptive telepathic waves that disrupt the triggering creature's magic. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use your attack roll modifier with your mageslayer claw.

name: Parallel Self
text: You briefly merge with an alternate version of yourself. Once per day as a 2-action activity, you gain the benefits of any one general or skill feat for 1 minute, even if you don't meet its prerequisites.

name: Paranoid Lookout
text: You are ever vigilant and refuse to be caught unaware, always watching for enemies. Whether agents of Kadrical or corporate spies come after you, you'll be ready to move quickly if they appear. When you roll initiative while using the Scout exploration activity, you can roll twice and take the better result.

name: Pardon Me
text: You distract your foes with a clever comment as you maneuver around them. You can use deception|against:will|options:action:tumble-through instead of Acrobatics to Tumble Through using the target's Will DC instead of Reflex DC. When you successfully Tumble Through using Deception, the foe whose space you passed through is Suppressed until the end of its next turn.

name: Parkour
text: You dash forward, unhindered by obstacles or walls. Stride and Long Jump or High Jump (in any order). You must start your movement on a horizontal surface. During this movement, you can ignore difficult terrain and run up vertical surfaces, like walls, at your full Speed. If you end the Stride off the ground, you fall after taking your next action or when your turn ends, whichever comes first (though you can Grab an Edge, if applicable).

name: Partial Corpsefolk
text: You died from massive traumatic injuries that caused you to lose body parts, or you rotted for a long time before you were brought back as an undead. There is no hiding your undead nature from onlookers unless you are wholly disguised, but you can manipulate your broken shards in creative ways. Your reduced mass gives you a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed. In addition, you can spend 1 action that has the manipulate trait to break off a jagged piece of your own body to create a commercial Knife. You can create a number of knives at a time equal to your Constitution modifier. They can't be sold and don't function for others. Effects that enhance your natural attacks, such as hardlight handwraps, apply their effects to a commercial knife created in this way while you're wielding it.

name: Partitioned Focus
text: Frequency once per day Your brain can process complex calculations subconsciously and save the answers for when they're needed most. You gain 1 Focus Point. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, you lose it.

name: Passive Environment Processing
text: Even while otherwise preoccupied, you can dedicate some of your brains to scanning your environment for threats. You can cast scan environment as a primal innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You can cast this innate cantrip even while performing other tasks, such as resting, traveling, talking, fighting, or even casting other spells, but not while sleeping or otherwise Unconscious. Additionally, once per day when you cast scan environment, you can change its casting time to 1 round instead of 10 minutes.

name: Passive Income
text: You're a creditor who has done business with many, many debtors. You can using Intimidation as long as you're in a settlement or other area where your debtors have access to you. When you Earn Income using Intimidation, you spend no time gathering money; instead, it's delivered to you by a debtor at the end of the day, allowing you to simultaneously perform other downtime activities as long as you can still spend a few minutes every hour interacting with your debtors (such as Earning an Income by running a bar or Retraining at a gymnasium).

name: Patient Waiter
text: In traditional processes, a large part of an individual's life is spent waiting; you add value by reducing the amount of time wasted by waiting. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

name: Pause Button
text:
Frequency once per day
You vanish from existence, severing your connection to reality for a moment. You cease to exist and disappear from your space, ending all ongoing conditions or effects on you. You return to the same space (or the closest unoccupied space if the same space is then occupied) immediately before the start of your next turn. When you return, you regain any ongoing conditions or effects from before you disappeared.

name: Peaceful Resolution
text: Hylax teaches peace, even when bloodshed seems inevitable in a given situation, and that diffusing a fight is always worth a try. Before you reach the point of no return, you make one last overture to your foe using all the wisdom that you've learned from the elders, your religion, or your family. You gain the Legendary Negotiation feat even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites. If you are in combat and haven't struck the opponent you're attempting to negotiate with, the penalty to your Diplomacy check is reduced to –2.

name: Peacekeeper Adornments
text: You customize your armor with the symbols and seals of your command. You treat medium armor as light armor when determining your proficiency, and you treat heavy armor as medium armor. You customize your armor with Peacekeeper Adornments, gaining the armor specialization effects of that armor. While wearing this armor, you gain an item bonus to Intimidation checks equal to your armor's resilience value.

name: Peacekeeper Dedication
text: You make peace with a grin and a gun. You become trained in Society or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You have familiarity with weapons with the nonlethal trait—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Peacekeeper's Armory
text: You've drilled with countless weapons. You become trained in all martial weapons. If you're already trained in martial weapons, you become expert in a single weapon you're trained in. Special: You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you become expert in a weapon you're trained in.

name: Peek
text: You shoot and then duck out of the way to avoid retaliation and errant gunfire. Make a ranged Strike, then Take Cover.

name: Perfect Aim
text: When you use Aim, the additional precision damage dice cannot be reduced by resistance or immunity. Additionally, the minimum result of each precision damage die is 2.

name: Perfect Synergy
text: Frequency once per round You've mastered the art of collaboration, developing a means to lend others your own energy and cognitive capability. An ally within 30 feet is Quickened for 1 round. They can use this extra action only to Stride or Strike. That ally is temporarily immune to Perfect Synergy for 10 minutes.

name: Perfected Flight
text: You can fly with almost perfect precision, almost as if the sky itself was on your side, even against prevailing wind conditions, steep dives, sharp turns, or worse. You gain the Assurance feat in Acrobatics, and if you have the Practiced Flight feat, your circumstance bonus to Maneuver in Flight increases to +3. Finally, you can hover in place without spending an action.

name: Perfectly Balanced
text: You've come closer to finding balance between two extremes of energy, learning how to expel or draw in excess heat when necessary. You gain resistance 5 to cold and fire. Additionally, you gain the Redirect Energy reaction.

name: Perfectly-Attuned
text: You have absolute control and understanding of your attunement with the stellar forces of the cosmos. If you would become graviton- or photon-attuned, you instead become perfectly-attuned. When you're perfectly-attuned, you can choose which attunement bonus to benefit from (either graviton- or photon-attuned) when using any of your abilities. If any of your abilities require you to be in a specific attunement state, being perfectly-attuned counts as your choice of graviton- or photon-attuned.

text: Trigger: An ally within 30 feet of you critically fails a Strike You quickly review your ally's strategy and give them the advice they need to improve their performance. The next Strike the triggering ally makes before the end of their turn has the same multiple attack penalty as the critically failed Strike, but it counts toward their multiple attack penalty as normal.

name: Peril Delver
text: You know how to spot trouble. When using the exploration activity, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll instead of +1, but your allies still only receive a +1. Special: If you have Incredible Initiative, you instead gain a +3 circumstance bonus to your initiative when using the Scout exploration activity.

name: Permanent Mod
text: As a 10-minute activity (concentrate, manipulate), apply one permanent mod to a non-consumable item. This mod doesn't count toward your number of maintained mods and lasts until you next apply a mod this way.

name: Persistent Confidence
text: You always believe in yourself. You can use Confident Actualization once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Persistent Protection
text: You trust that your deceased bonded partner is with you, even from beyond the grave. You can use Spirit's Protection once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Persistent Quantum Field
text: Frequency once per day You can create a stable quantum field. You Warp Reality with a duration of 1 minute.

name: Persistent Tactics
text: You've learned which survival tactics work best for you and rely on them frequently. Select one of the following feats or abilities you possess: Puff Up, Shed Skin, Squirt Blood. You can use the selected ability once per 10 minutes, rather than once per hour. Special You can take this feat more than once, selecting a different ability each time.

name: Personal Legend
text: You've begun to develop your personal legend about nuar history, tailored from your own study and interests. While not necessarily factual, the legend is captivating when you tell it. You can use any Lore skill in which you're trained to [[/act make-an-impression]] or [[/act create-a-diversion]], instead of using Diplomacy and Deception respectively. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your Diplomacy checks using Lore if the target isn't interested in or trained in the same or a related Lore skill (creatures are trained in the skills listed in their stat blocks).

name: Personal Sacrifice
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You are about to attempt a skill check, attack roll, or saving throw. In this world, there are few things more noble than a personal sacrifice. You use one of your personal trinkets to empower yourself. You do not roll the triggering check but instead earn a critical success. When you use this ability, the personal trinket is destroyed.

name: Personal Trinket
text: You have an object that comforts you, such as a favorite rock, a childhood stuffed animal, or another trinket. While you hold your personal trinket, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws and to Will DCs against fear effects. If your personal trinket is ever lost or destroyed, you can gain another one by spending 1 week of downtime searching for a suitable replacement. Additionally, you gain the Self Soothe action.

name: Petal Storm
text: You shed a cloud of petals to distract foes. Once per day as a single action, creatures in a 5-foot emanation become flat-footed until the start of your next turn.

name: Pharmacologically Impervious
text: A common way to try to stave off the Bleaching is to experiment with substances. As a result, each new generation of gnomes becomes more inured to toxic and hazardous materials. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases and poisons.

name: Pheremone Connection
text: You learned to manipulate your pheromones in compensation for a lack of telepathy.

name: Pheromone Connection
text: You learned to manipulate your pheromones in compensation for a lack of telepathy. You can [[/act make-an-impression traits=olfactory]] with your pheromones, which causes your attempt to lose the auditory and linguistic traits and instead gain the olfactory trait. If you use your pheromones to enhance your speech (by retaining the auditory and linguistic traits while also adding the olfactory trait to the action), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. When modified in this way, a failure on a check to Make an Impression becomes a critical failure instead.

name: Philosophical Damnation
text: Your understanding of the underlying nature of the multiverse allows you to call into question the existence of other beings. Once per day, you can cast as an 8th-rank divine innate spell.

name: Philosophical Font
text: You constantly accumulate knowledge about philosophies and multiversal understanding. During your daily preparations, you can call upon that knowledge and gain the trained proficiency rank in two Lore skills of your choice related to philosophies, religions, or the cosmos. You might select something like Abaddon Lore and Prophecies of Kalistrade Lore or Pharasma Lore and Boneyard Lore. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

name: Philosphical Damnation
text: Your understanding of the underlying nature of the multiverse allows you to call into question the existence of other beings.

name: Phishing Expertise
text: Your skill at social engineering extends to digital space. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Computers checks to send deceptive communications or obtain credentials through digital trickery.

name: Photon Absorption
text: While in photon mode, once per round when you take fire, electricity, or laser damage, you can absorb some of it into your stellar energy, reducing the damage by 3d6.

name: Photosynthesis
text: You absorb energy from light. While in an area of bright light for at least 1 minute, you regain 1d4 HP and don't need rations for the day.

name: Photosynthetic Regeneration
text: Frequency once per day Requirements You're exposed to natural sunlight. Your body regenerates by taking in nutrients from natural sunlight. You gain regeneration 20 for 1 minute.

name: Phreaker
text: You can exploit digital infrastructure with ease. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Computers checks to hack and can attempt to access secure systems without the proper credentials by succeeding on a DC 25 Computers check.

name: Pick On Someone My Size
text: You know how to talk down creatures of larger size from making the mistake of attacking your allies. You become trained in Intimidation, or you gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat if you were already trained. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]] creatures of a larger size than you that attacked an ally since the beginning of your last turn.

name: Picklecore Music
text: Picklecore, a blend of improvised jug band music, electronica, and power tools, is your jam. Attempt a check against the Will DC of a single enemy or willing ally within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check to sing. This can affect up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Performance, four if you have master proficiency, and eight if you have legendary proficiency. Critical Success If the target doesn't have the goblin trait, they become until the start of your next turn or the next time they're hit by a Strike, whichever comes first. If the target has the goblin trait, they instead gain a +5-foot status bonus to its Speeds for 1 round. name: Pickpocket
text: Your nimble fingers are quick and subtle. You can Steal an object that's actively guarded or stowed without the normal penalty, and you can Palm an Object as a free action.

name: Piezo Ink
text:
Frequency once per day

You can spend 10 minutes mixing piezoelectric sand with ink in order to write text with a hidden trap for any creature who places pressure upon the words, glyphs, or pictures within a written document. This has the effects of a Glyph of Warding holding a shocking grasp, with a few exceptions, and it counts towards your limit for active glyphs of warding. First, it can be used to place traps among written words or pictures in a written document instead of containers or areas. Second, it's pressure sensitive, so it triggers on any creature who places pressure on it, instead of only on certain creatures. However, if you remember where the traps are hidden within a text, you can avoid placing pressure in those spots. As normal for glyph of warding, it only triggers when another creature touches it, not when you force the object on the creature. The constant vigorous motion of armor and wielded handheld items like shields and weapons make them unsuitable for a trap using your Piezo Ink even if the shield, weapon, or armor contained written documents as part of its construction, as the pressure and motion from use would cause them to trigger on you before you could try to trick an enemy into applying pressure onto them.

name: Piloting Expertise
text: Your skills at the helm are extraordinary. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks and can take 10 on Piloting checks for routine maneuvers in combat.

name: Pin Down
text: Trigger A creature you're observing succeeds at their saving throw against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire attack. You focus your weapons fire on a resilient target in order to suppress them with the sheer ferocity of your assault. The required target must succeed at a will|against:soldier save against your class DC or become Suppressed until the start of your next turn.

name: Pinpoint Thoughtsense
text: You can track the minds around you with astonishing precision. Your thoughtsense becomes a precise sense.

name: Pirate Spell
text: When you successfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can install a temporary copy of that spell into your spell cache, lasting until you Download a Spell to replace a prepared spell with it or your next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

name: Pirate's Parry
text:
Trigger An adjacent enemy attempts a melee Strike against you.

Requirements You are wielding a gun and a melee weapon with the agile trait or a phase cutlass.
You parry the triggering Strike with your melee weapon, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against the attack. If the triggering Strike is a critical failure, you may attempt a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This ranged Strike does not trigger reactions from the target.

name: Planar Artist
text:
Frequency once per hour

You can shape your planar infusion with objects you imagine and bring to life through art, decorating it with all sorts of elysian whimsy. While within either your hoard or campsite planar infusion, you can spend 1 minute to create an object that can only exist within your infusion. It must be made of vegetable matter (such as wood or paper) or a common mineral, and be 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, and can't be made of precious materials or materials with a rarity of uncommon or higher. It is whimsical in design and obviously only exists within your planar infusion, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item.

You can have one such item in existence at any given time in each of your planar infusions. If the item would leave the planar infusion, if you move your planar infusion somewhere else, or if you use Planar Artist again to create another item within the same planar infusion, the previous item you created with Planar Artist fades out of existence in a splash of color.

name: Planar Infusion
text:
You can infuse the area around you with planar energy after a time, making it harder to use magic opposed to your associated plane. You can have two planar infusions active at any given time, a hoard infusion and a campsite infusion. Your hoard infusion requires you to remain in continuous residence for 1 week at a location with no other owners, or whose other owners are willing to allow you to infuse the area. When you finish, the area becomes infused with planar energies to the edge of the property, cave, or other location, to a maximum of a 60-foot radius. The infusion remains until you infuse another lair elsewhere, though it might disperse if you remain away for a long period of time. For every month in which you don't return to your lair, roll a Flat check. On a failure, the lair's planar infusion ends.

At the same time as your lair planar infusion, you can also have a smaller camp planar infusion. Whenever you remain within a room, cavern, clearing, or other campsite with a maximum of a 20-footradius area for at least 2 hours, you can choose to make that area into a campsite infusion. Your campsite infusion only lasts as long as you remain within the 20-foot-radius area. The moment you leave, the planar infusion immediately ends.

Both your hoard and campsite planar infusions make it difficult to cast spells opposed to your associated plane. When attempting to Cast a Spell or Activate an Item with the listed alignment traits (or that creates or summons undead, for crypt dragons), a creature must succeed at a Flat check or lose the spell or activation. The hindered traits depend on your heritage:

• Apocalypse dragon good spells and magic items.

• Bliss dragon evil spells and magic items.

• Crypt dragon spells and magic items that create or summon undead, as well as spells that specify that they benefit only undead, such as necromancer's generosity.

• Edict dragon chaotic spells and magic items.

• Havoc dragon evil and lawful spells and magic items.

• Infernal dragon chaotic and good spells and magic items.

• Paradise dragon chaotic and evil spells and magic items.

• Rift dragon good and lawful spells and magic items.

• Tumult dragon lawful spells and magic items.

name: Planar Survival
text: You can Subsist using Survival on different planes, even those without resources or natural phenomena you normally need. For instance, you can forage for food without penalty even if the plane lacks food that could normally sustain you. A success on your check to Subsist also prevents damage done by the plane to you and anyone else you support with Subsist. This applies only to damage dealt by the general conditions of the plane, not smaller hazards.

name: Planetary Bond
text:
Your bond has grown into a kinship with all that lives on your planet. You're constantly under the effects of Speak with Animals and Speak with Plants while on your planet. You are considered a native of any planet in your bond. Creatures native to your planet feel an instinctual connection to you, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks when making a Request from them. Particularly helpful creatures may agree to minor tasks like delivering messages or spying on an area, but they won't do dangerous jobs or fight for you.

You vow to protect your bonded world. Gain the following edicts and anathemas.

Edicts defend your world from extraterrestrial threats, protect its natural resources from exploitation, form bonds with lifeforms on your planet

Anathemas disturb or harm your planet's ecosystem, plunder your planet's natural resources, exploit your planet's lifeforms

If your powers are lost due to anathema, you lose the effects of this feat and cannot bond with another planet only if you repent by conducting an Atone ritual.

name: Planetary Reincarnation
text: Your bonded world revives you. Add breath of life to your primal spell list. While on a bonded planet, if you cast Breath of Life and target a member of your bond, Transfer Vitality to restore Hit Points to the target. If you do, the target regains additional Hit Points equal to their level (without spending any Hit Points from your vitality network), if they also follow the edicts and anathema of Planetary Bond. If you are on a bonded planet, you can cast breath of life on yourself when you would die, even if you are Unconscious.

name: Plant Empathy
text: You commune with plant life. You can communicate simple concepts to plants and receive impressions about recent events in the area. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Nature checks involving plants.

name: Plant Rumor
text: You can seed rumors that spread on their own. You can use Deception to plant a rumor; on a success, the rumor spreads through a community without further effort from you.

name: Plantlike
text: You can become virtually indistinguishable from a common tree or tangled vines. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks when you're in a natural area that contains flora, and you can use Deception to Impersonate plant life, including stationary plants like shrubs or plant creatures like ksariks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to these checks.

name: Plasma Ejection
text: You unleash an ejection of plasma, hitting every creature in your choice of a type:emanation|distance:10 or in a type:line|distance:30. Each creature in the area takes ((1 + floor(@actor.level / 2))d6)[fire|options:area-damage,plasma-ejection-base-damage] damage with a reflex|against:solarian|basic|options:area-effect save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails its save additionally takes 1d8[persistent,electricity] damage. Graviton-Attuned A creature that fails its save is knocked Prone. Photon-Attuned Increase the fire damage to d8s. Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6 (or 1d8 if you're photon-attuned).

name: Plated Deflection
text: You've mastered using your own plate scales or worn armor to absorb devastating strikes. You gain the Plate Deflection reaction.

name: Plentiful Bile
text: You have an unending supply of toxins and bile. Select one of the following abilities you possess: Coat in Bile, Slitherskin, or Spew Acidic Bile. If you selected Coat in Bile or Spew Acidic Bile, the frequency of the selected ability becomes once per 10 minutes, rather than once per day. If you selected Slitherskin, the frequency of Slitherskin becomes once per 10 minutes, rather than once per hour. Special You can take this feat more than once, selecting a different ability you possess each time.

name: Plentiful Cirrisensors
text: You've acclimated to constantly using multiple cirrisensors in all directions as a defense mechanism. You can't be flanked by creatures of your level or lower.

name: Power Slide
text: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit. You Drive with a –2 penalty to your Piloting check, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Power Slide. At the end of the movement, if you succeed, you can turn the vehicle up to 90 degrees. If you critically succeed at your Piloting check, you can instead turn the vehicle up to 180 degrees.

name: Powered Armor Proficiency
text: You are trained in the use of powered armor and can wear and operate it without penalty, treating it as the heavy armor category for proficiency purposes.

name: Powerful Exhalation
text: Your ability to breathe energy is unparalleled. The area of your Dragonkin Breath increases to a type:cone|distance:30 and the damage dice are d6s instead of d4s. If you have the critical specialization effect of any weapon, a creature that gets a critical failure on their Reflex save against your dragonkin breath are affected by its corresponding critical weapon specialization effect.

name: Powerful Grapple
text: Your massive claws excel at grabbing. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics to Grapple, and creatures you've grabbed take a penalty to Escape.

name: Powerful Leap
text: You can jump 5 feet up with a vertical Leap without making a High Jump. You also increase the horizontal distance when you Leap, including as part of a High Jump or Long Jump, by 5 feet.

name: Powerful Limbs
text: It's not your fault being the biggest and the strongest. When fighting is inevitable, you've learned to use your superior bulk to grab and restrain smaller enemies. If nothing else, a foe in your grasp is less likely to harm your allies. Your powerful upper limbs have had plenty of practice wrestling, grabbing, and restraining smaller foes. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to [[/act grapple]] foes that are at least one size category smaller than you.

name: Practical Theologian
text: Your research and your religion make up two sides of the same coin for you, and to grow in one means to grow in both. You become trained in one Lore skill of your choice. Whenever your proficiency in Religion increases to expert or better, you also gain that new proficiency rank with the chosen Lore skill.

name: Practiced Escape
text: Trigger A creature Grabs, Immobilizes, or Restrains you. You've trained in close quarters combat and practiced how to escape a hold, or similar situations. You attempt to Escape. If you succeed or critically succeed, you can also Stand or Step.

name: Practiced Flight
text: You might or might not be able to fly on your own yet, but either way, but you've been restoring the pathways that make you a better flier, so whenever you do fly, you do so faster and more effectively. Whenever you have a fly Speed, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your fly Speed and a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight. If you are a master in Acrobatics, the status bonus to your fly Speed increases to a +10-foot bonus, and if you are legendary in Acrobatics, the status bonus to your fly Speed increases to a +15-foot bonus.

name: Practiced Leader
text: Your guidance provides your allies with exceptional assistance on tasks that are second nature to you. When your allies Follow the Expert and choose you as their expert, they gain a +3 circumstance bonus if you're an expert in the skill, or a +4 circumstance bonus if you're at least a master in the skill.

name: Practiced Navigator
text: You've traveled to hundreds of places scattered across dozens of worlds and glimpsed wonders both beautiful and strange. When you roll a success on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot Course, or on a Survival check to Sense Direction, you get a critical success instead. In addition, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed during overland travel.

name: Practiced Professional
text: Your attention to detail makes you stand out in your field, and your work comes to you automatically at the direst times. Gain the feat for a skill of your choice. When you make an attack with a weapon that has the professional trait for a skill for which you have Assurance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

name: Practiced Purification
text: Frequency twice per day You've studied medicine further to help others overcome illness and addiction. Choose an affliction and up to two of the following conditions affecting an adjacent ally: Confused, Controlled, Drained, Frightened, Sickened, Stupefied. You reduce the stage of that affliction by 1 and the value of the conditions by 1. If the target still has the affliction or at least one of the conditions, attempt a medicine check to counteract those remaining afflictions and conditions. Your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Practiced Scion
text: You've honed your primal connection to the fonqon trees. Choose one 1st-rank primal spell and one 2nd-rank primal spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as primal innate spells.

name: Precise Coagulation
text: You can precisely control your oozy body's coagulation when you're wounded to prevent unwanted seepage. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.

name: Precision Strike
text: You leverage a free arm to guide your attacks. Once per round, you can use a free hand to steady your weapon, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to your next ranged or melee attack roll.

name: Predator's Eye
text: Your eye magnifies distant targets as well as a scope. You can adjust your sight in that eye as a single action to Seek a specific creature with a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception check, or Seek to search a 10-foot square up to 100 feet away for any undetected or Hidden creatures or objects. You don't take penalties for an object or creature being too far away unless you're more than 2 miles away.

name: Predatory
text: Battle is a dance, and you've honed your body into an instrument as exquisite as it is deadly. When you select this feat, you gain your choice of a claw unarmed attack or a jaws unarmed attack. Both of these attacks are in the brawling weapon group. A claw unarmed attack deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, pahtra, and unarmed traits. A jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the finesse, grapple, pahtra, and unarmed traits. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect. Special You can take this feat a second time. If you do, select the other attack from the options above.

name: Predatory Trance
text: Frequency once per minute You're an experienced warrior who can tap into your predatory instincts and completely focus on a single creature you can detect—to the exclusion of everything else. Those incapable of understanding these instincts might even believe you've lost your senses. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph, or polymorph effect on a target, but only for the purposes of determining whether you see through it, with a counteract rank of 6 and a counteract modifier equal to your Perception modifier. You get a +2 status bonus to Perception checks when you [[/act seek]] the chosen creature and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the chosen creature, but all other creatures become hidden to you. This lasts 1 minute, until the target dies, or until you fall Unconscious, whichever comes first. If you take damage, you can voluntarily end your trance as a reaction, which has the concentrate trait.

name: Predict Outcome
text: Frequency once per hour You spend 10 minutes opening yourself to the mysteries of the multiverse by peering across different timelines or analyzing probability simulations. You gain the effects of Augury, except you learn only about the dangers ahead; any results of "good" are instead "nothing," and results of "mixed" are instead "bad." If you're legendary in Arcana or Occultism, you take only 1 minute to Predict Outcome.

You instantly teleport up to your Speed to an area within your quantum field. This movement doesn't trigger reactions based on movement and ignores hazards and terrain, but can't pass through walls or other such obstructions.

text: Frequency: once per 10 minutes Requirements: The target is within range of your limited telepathy. You reach out and sense the surface thoughts of your foe, helping you predict exactly where they're going to be so you can strike true. Attempt a Perception check to Sense Motive. Success The next time you make an attack roll against the target, roll twice and use the better result. If your attack is a critical hit, the target is so surprised by the efficacy of your attack that they're also until the beginning of your next turn.

text: One of your tails or tendrils functions like an extra hand and is capable of performing some precision tasks. You can hold one extra hand's worth of equipment with your prehensile limb, and you can use your prehensile limb to perform Interact actions. Your prehensile limb can be paired with another hand when you designate your active hands with the Switch Hands action, and you can wield a shield or weapon in your prehensile limb when it's one of your active hands.

name: Prehistoric Might
text: Your predatory heritage is expressed in raw power. Your natural weapons deal 1d8 damage instead of 1d6, and your unarmed Strikes gain the forceful trait.

name: Prescient Consumable
text: You can predict which consumables you might need in advance. When using Prescient Planner, you can procure a consumable item from your backpack, instead of a piece of adventuring gear. The consumable item must still be common with a level no higher than half your level, and its Bulk must be low enough that carrying it wouldn't have made you encumbered.

name: Prescient Planner
text: Cost the Price of the chosen item Requirements You haven't used this ability since the last time you were able to purchase goods. You regularly create convoluted plans and contingencies, using your resources to enact them. You take 1 minute to remove your backpack, then carefully remove an item you hadn't previously declared that you purchased—you intuited that you would come to need the item and purchased it at the latest opportunity. The item must be a piece of adventuring gear, and can't be a weapon, armor, serum, magic item, or other treasure. It must be common with a level no higher than half your level, and its Bulk must be low enough that carrying it wouldn't have made you encumbered.

name: Press Your Luck
text: Now that you've gained otherworldly control over your own luck, you've learned to share your fortune with your allies. When an ally you can see rolls your lucky number, you can pass the good luck over to them and change their roll to a 20. Doing so counts as using your lucky number for the day.

name: Press-Gang the Soul
text:
Trigger You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points with a phase cutlass.
Your phase cutlass steals some of the enemy's vitality, press-ganging it into eternal servitude. As long as you are wielding a Phase Cutlass with stolen vitality, you can cast Wisp Ally as a divine innate spell at will, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level. Using wisp ally this way requires and permanently releases one soul press-ganged with your phase cutlass. The first time each round you Strike with your phase cutlass, you immediately gain the effects of the Sustain a Spell action, which you can use only to extend the duration of and control a wisp ally spell cast using that phase cutlass.

name: Pressure Plates
text: Frequency once per round Requirements You're taking persistent bleed damage. When you're bleeding, you can strategically realign your chitinous plates to apply pressure, staunch your wounds, and improve your chances of stopping the bleeding altogether. Attempt a flat check to recover from the persistent bleed damage. The DC of this check is 10 instead of 15. Even if you fail, the DC of the recovery check to stop the bleeding at the end of your turn is reduced to 10 this round as well.

name: Preternatural Skill
text: Your ability to focus on your interests encourages rapid talent growth, allowing you to leap ahead in your studies. You gain the feat for up to two Lore skills you're trained in. You can retrain Preternatural Skill to gain Assurance for one different Lore skill with 1 day of downtime.

name: Prey's Attendance
text: You're practiced in keeping your eyestalks moving independently to better monitor for threats. This allows you to keep an eye on everything nearby and have battlefield control. You gain all-around vision. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.

name: Primafloral Adaptation
text: You can draw on a wellspring of primal power to cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.m2xFMNyQiUKQDRaj as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day.

name: Primal Ooze
text: You were born from a fonqon tree that was especially suffused with primal energies. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against primal spells and effects.

name: Primal Polyps
text: You've reconnected with some of the primal cosmic power of Tabrid Minor's copi, and it infuses the polyps of your body with energy. You can cast Sound Body and Unfettered Movement as 7th-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

name: Primal Vitality
text: As far removed as you might be from your First World ancestry, some spark of it still beats within you, giving you a supernaturally powerful connection to life. You Stride twice and can pass through other creatures' spaces without needing to [[/act tumble-through]]. Creatures of your choice whose space you pass through recover ] Hit Points equal to your level. A creature with void healing treats this as a void effect. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the end of your movement. These last for 1 minute.

name: Primary Target
text: You gain the primary target class feature.

name: Prime Inheritor
text: You're the inheritor of your progenitor star's stellar glory. Your mere presence terrifies your enemies and emboldens your allies. You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. This bonus increases to +4 against novians. In addition, you gain the Unleash Majesty action.

name: Prismatic Display
text: You rapidly shift the colors of your skin to throw off the senses of those around you. Attempt a deception|against:perception check against the Perception DCs of all creatures within melee reach. On a success, the creature becomes Clumsy 1 until the end of your turn (Clumsy 2 on a critical success). Regardless of the result of your check, each creature is then temporarily immune to Prismatic Display for 10 minutes.

name: Prismeni Lore
text:
You've learned to leverage your intrinsic link to the Drift, making you an excellent pilot. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Piloting and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Prismeni Lore.

name: Probability Shield
text: You surround an ally with protective probability. As a reaction when an ally within 60 feet would be hit by an attack, they gain a +3 status bonus to AC against that attack (applied retroactively — the attack might miss).

name: Probability Shift
text: Your instinctive grasp of probability lets you turn luck against your foes. Once per day, after seeing a die result, you can force the triggering creature to reroll and use the lower result.

name: Programming Prodigy
text: You gain the Magical Shorthand skill feat without meeting its prerequisites. Also, when you roll a critical failure to Learn a Spell, you get a failure instead.

name: Proleptic Parry
text: Trigger A Telepredicted creature targets you with a mental effect. Requirements You have a bonus against the target using Telepredict. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws against the triggering effect. Increase this bonus to +2 if you've dealt mental damage to the target since the last time you used Telepredict. If you roll a critical success on the saving throw, the target takes 5d4[mental] damage and becomes Stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn.

name: Promising Pharmaceutical
text: You've learned to distill your blood into a potent pharmaceutical. During your daily preparations, you can create one dose of this medicine, which is a unique consumable serum with the effects of both a tactical medpatch and an advanced hypopen. This medicine remains potent until your next daily preparations, at which point it breaks down and is useless. You can never sell the medicine created in this way. At 13th level, your medicine instead functions as both an advanced medpatch and a superior hypopen. At 17th level, your medicine instead functions as both a superior medpatch and an elite hypopen.

name: Prop Closet
text: You've practiced enough with prop replica weapons that you can draw on these experiences in a real fight. Select a common advanced or martial weapon. You have familiarity with this weapon for the purposes of proficiency, and you treat this advanced weapon as a martial weapon, or martial weapon as a simple weapon. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with this weapon, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Propelled Polyp Print
text: You have remarkable control over the polyps on your body. When you cast Telekinetic Hand, as long as you have line of effect and line of sight to your hand, you can use your telekinetic hand as the origin point for your spells that have a line or cone area. Additionally, you gain the Polyp Print activity.

name: Prophet
text: You can divine the future. You can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k and Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n each once per day as 4th-rank spells. The tradition of this spell matches the tradition of the cantrip you gained from Sigiled Scales. At 17th level, the rank of vision of death increases to 6th.

name: Prophet's Premonition
text: Your magical scale markings give you insight into the future. You can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X twice per day as a 2nd-rank spell. The tradition of this spell matches the tradition of the cantrip you gained from Sigiled Scales.

name: Propulsive Shield
text: You fire blasts of solar energy through your raised shield, harnessing its gravitational force to propel your attacks. When you make a solar flare Strike while you have your solar shield raised, increase the range increment of your solar flare by 10 feet and increase the damage your solar flare deals by 1 per weapon damage die. Graviton-Attuned The additional damage is bludgeoning damage. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the Trip attempt on a critical success. Photon-Attuned The additional damage is fire damage. Increase the persistent fire damage on a critical success to 1d8.

name: Protect the Pack
text: Requirements You're adjacent to an ally. You're determined to protect your allies from harm—even if it hurts! Select one adjacent ally. Until the beginning of your next turn, you shield them with your body; any lesser cover you grant them is instead standard cover, though they can't use standard cover granted by you to Hide.

name: Protection of the Past
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You would fail a save against a spell or effect with the void trait. The darkness between the stars isn't simply a void for your people, it's a storehouse for a great reserve of energy, built by generation after generation of maraquois. When the darkness threatens to take hold of you, the power of that ancestral wellspring swells forth and lifts you up. You reroll the triggering saving throw with a +1 status bonus. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.

name: Protective Bulk
text: No matter the dangers posed to your person, you've always prioritized the safety of your allies over your own wellbeing. Whenever you Raise a Shield or position a weapon with the parry trait defensively, you can choose to increase the AC of up to two adjacent allies instead of your own. If you have the Stretching Reach feat, increase the effective range of your protection by 5 feet. As long as the selected allies remain within your reach and your shield is raised, they gain the circumstance bonus to AC from your shield or weapon, while you take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC while concentrating on the defense of those around you. Special If you have the Shield Block feat, during this time, you can trigger Shield Block when you have your shield raised and one of the selected allies would take damage from a physical attack, but you can't use Shield Block to protect yourself.

name: Protective Subroutine
text: Your nanites augment your defenses.

name: Prototype Electroencephalon
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes Trigger You're critically hit by an attack. When Eox's atmosphere burned, necrovites crafted devices called electroencephalons in order to house their souls and transition themselves into undead beings who could survive the eons since that cataclysmic event. You've learned the basics of this technology and have crafted a similar device. Attempt a flat|dc:10. On a success, the triggering hit becomes a normal hit.

name: Proudhome Puff
text: You've integrated a fungal biotech to help manage your growth. You vent spores from your body in a , dealing |options:area-damage] damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The damage increases by 1d4 for every two levels you have beyond 13th level. A creature that fails its save is also Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). You can't use Proudhome Puff again for 1d4 rounds.

name: Proximity Alert Mines
text: When you Deploy a Mine, you can make it a proximity alert mine that automatically Detonates when a creature enters or leaves a square within its burst area (this takes no action, and you can't delay the detonation).

name: Psychic Bully
text: You can leverage your telepathic abilities to influence the minds of others, imparting orders or inflaming fears. You can cast Command and Fear as 1st-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

name: Psychic Constellation
text: You effortlessly juggle an assortment of gear with your telepathy, giving you the appearance of a solar cerebellum orbited by planetoid items. You gain a second set of telekinetic hands, per Mind Over Matter, granting a typical contemplative six hands total. While at least one of your telekinetic hands is empty, you can deflect incoming attacks, granting your fist attack the parry trait. You gain the Eccentric Orbit free action.

name: Psychic Droning
text: Frequency once per hour You let out a psychic droning sound that interferes with telepathic communication. Other creatures in a around you must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is Deafened and is unable to communicate telepathically for 1 round. Failure As success, and the creature also takes |options:area-damage] damage. Critical Failure As success, and the creature also takes |options:area-damage] damage and is Confused until the end of their next turn.

name: Psychic Fungal Mastery
text: Your potent psychic powers have steadily grown as you and your host's minds merge and evolve, granting you additional magic. Choose one 1st-rank or 2nd-rank spell with the fungus or plant trait or from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell once per day.

name: Psychic Fungus
text: You've awakened dormant psychic abilities in your host by unlocking atrophied sensory and nervous organs. Choose one cantrip that has the fungus or plant trait or is from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Psychic Insight
text: Your psychic perception lets you anticipate danger. You gain detect thoughts as an innate spell castable once per day.

name: Psychic Interrogation
text: Requirements: You share a language with the target, who is in range of your limited telepathy. You mentally ambush a creature. Telepathically ask a question of a non-allied creature that you can see within range of your limited telepathy. The target must attempt a saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to your Psychic Interrogation for 1 hour. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target is slightly distracted by your question and can't use reactions until the end of your next turn. Failure The target's mind is consumed by the thought of your question. They can't use reactions until the end of your next turn and are Stupefied 1 for 1 minute. They can end the stupefied condition early by taking an action to telepathically reply to your question. They don't have to answer truthfully, but you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the target attempts to Lie to you, which increases to +4 if you have the Psychic Investigation feat. Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes Stupefied 2.

name: Psychic Investigation
text: You're constantly casting your mind out as you search for clues. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive and to Seek creatures who aren't immune to mental effects and within range of your limited telepathy, and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against such creatures attempting to Lie to you.

name: Psychic Investigator
text: You can use your telepathic abilities to quickly assess your circumstances or subtly glean information from the minds of others. You can cast Hypercognition and Mind Reading as 3rd-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

name: Psychic Master
text: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.

name: Psychic Mastery
text: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger, allowing you to tap into entirely new dimensions of psychic power. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.

name: Psychic Paragon
text: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger. Choose one common 6th-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.

name: Psychic Resilience
text:
Your resistance to mental effects expands beyond mental damage. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You gain the Resilient Mind free action.

Resilient Mind: Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll a success on a saving throw against a mental effect

Effect You bolster your mind to throw off the effect entirely. You get a critical success on the saving throw instead of a success.

name: Psychic Retaliation
text: The psychic static that shrouds your mind is a weapon as much as a defense. Whenever you use Static Shield and succeed at the triggering save, if the source of the mental effect was a creature, your psychic static lashes out at them and deals mental damage equal to half your level (or equal to your level on a critical success, ], ]).

name: Psychic Scholar
text: You can transfer vast amounts of information to the minds of others in mere moments. You can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs as a 1st-rank occult innate spell twice per day.

name: Psychic Talent
text: Your psychic abilities have developed beyond simple communication. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Psychic Talent
text: Your psychic abilities have developed beyond simple communication. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Psychic Wedge
text: Your mastery of your psychic powers makes your targets more susceptible to later spells. When a creature fails or critically fails a saving throw against one of your innate spells gained from an ancestry feat, they take a –1 status penalty to saving throws against your other innate spells until the end of your next turn.

name: Pull Into Orbit
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes You exert your gravitational field upon your surroundings, causing small objects, debris, and stellar ejecta from your own body to orbit you like miniature satellites. These satellites grant you lesser cover until the beginning of your next turn. At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, your satellites remain in orbit for 1 additional round, up to a maximum of 4 rounds at 17th level.

name: Pulonis Softstep
text: You're so light on your feet you can even move through tall grass without leaving any tracks. You gain the Feather Step general feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. You can Cover Tracks using Acrobatics instead of Survival.

name: Pulse Light
text: You surge your internal light in a brilliant flash, disorienting everyone nearby and revealing anything that would try to hide from your sight. You can cast Revealing Light as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell once per hour, except it doesn't dazzle moonflowers and moonflower leshies.

name: Pungent Astrazoan
text: You emit the reeking smell of rotting meat when you disgorge your stomach. While you can thoroughly mask the scent by shapeshifting to eat like other species, disgorging your stomach to intentionally emit this vile odor can come in handy when you are trying to dissuade predators, whether they are hungry beasts or murderous mobsters. You become trained in Deception and gain the Lengthy Diversion skill feat as a bonus feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites.

name: Punishing Salvo
text: Requirements Your last action this turn was an Area Fire attack. You know unleashing a barrage of gunfire can bring most enemies low. You make a follow-up Strike against your primary target using the same weapon. Ignore the unwieldy trait on your weapon when using this action. This doesn't make a new area attack and is treated as a Strike made using primary target.

name: Punishing Salvo
text:
Requirements Your last action this turn was an attack.

You know unleashing a barrage of gunfire can bring most enemies low. You make a follow-up Strike against your primary target using the same weapon. Ignore the unwieldy trait on your weapon when using this action. This doesn't make a new area attack and is treated as a Strike made using primary target.

name: Punitive Strike
text: Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action, makes a ranged Strike, uses a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it's using. Your foe's momentary lapse in defense gives you an opening Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature, ignoring the unwieldy trait on any weapons you're wielding for this Strike. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

name: Purge Stomach
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You gain the sickened condition or fail a save against an ingested poison. Requirements You can use Fire Breath. Thanks to control of your stomach, you can expel foreign substances in your body with ease. Reduce your sickened condition by 2, and immediately attempt a saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus against any ingested poisons you've been exposed to within the last minute. You can't use Fire Breath for 1d4 rounds.

name: Push It
text: Whenever you succeed at a Piloting check, the vehicle you're piloting gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to all its Speeds until the end of your turn. If you critically succeed, this bonus increases to +15 feet.

name: Put It Back Together
text: When outside technology started streaming into Marata, industrious maraquois didn't simply accept it: they wanted to learn how it worked. You love taking new toys apart to see what makes them tick—but unlike most, you can always put them back together. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft a formula by reverse engineering it from an item you possess.

name: Quad Juggle
text: When you take the Change Posture action, you can Switch Hands and put away or swap any number of items between your hands.

name: Quadrupedal Speed
text: You can run incredibly fast on all fours. Your Speed is 30 feet as long as you have two free hands.

name: Quantum Aura
text: You can become the nexus of the warped reality you create. Each time you use Warp Reality to activate your quantum field, you can choose for your quantum field to be an aura around you that moves with you. If you do, your Warp Reality action gains the aura trait, and the quantum field you create is a 10-foot-radius emanation.

name: Quantum Aura
text: You can become the nexus of the warped reality you create. Each time you use to activate your quantum field, you can choose for your quantum field to be an aura around you that moves with you. If you do, your Warp Reality action gains the aura trait, and the quantum field you create is a 10-foot-radius emanation.

name: Quantum Breadth
text: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your paradox's tradition each day. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from witchwarper archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest witchwarper spell slots.

name: Quantum Entanglement
text: You prevent creatures from leaving your quantum field and returning to reality. Until the start of your next turn, any creature who begins its turn inside your quantum field must succeed at a will|against:witchwarper saving throw against your witchwarper class DC to move outside your quantum field. On a failure, the action is disrupted. A creature that succeeds at this save is immune to your Quantum Entanglement for 24 hours.

name: Quantum Entanglement
text: You prevent creatures from leaving your quantum field and returning to reality. Until the start of your next turn, any creature who begins its turn inside your quantum field must succeed at a saving throw against your witchwarper class DC to move outside your quantum field. On a failure, the action is disrupted. A creature that succeeds at this save is immune to your Quantum Entanglement for 24 hours.

name: Quantum Negation
text: You expose a target to a reality in which they don't exist. You learn the Quantum Negation warp spell.

name: Quantum Negation
text: You expose a target to a reality in which they don't exist. You learn the warp spell.

name: Quantum Recycle
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You cast a 2nd-rank or higher spell, and the spell targets a creature or area within your quantum field. You expertly manipulate the effects of your quantum field to ensure that some of the energy from your spell is preserved and can be harnessed again. You regain an expended spell slot one spell rank lower than the triggering spell.

text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You cast a 2nd-rank or higher spell, and the spell targets a creature or area within your quantum field.

You expertly manipulate the effects of your quantum field to ensure that some of the energy from your spell is preserved and can be harnessed again. You regain an expended spell slot one spell rank lower than the triggering spell.

name: Quantum Research
text: You become a true embodiment of your paradox and surpass what mortals can achieve in your reality. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

name: Quantum Research
text: You become a true embodiment of your paradox and surpass what mortals can achieve in your reality. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

name: Quantum Step
text: You briefly step into a parallel reality and emerge at a different point. Once per day as a 2-action activity, you teleport up to 30 feet to a location you can see.

name: Queen's Magic
text: Except for queens, most formians possess little in the way of inherent magical ability. You're no queen, but you're in close proximity with your queen as a member of her court, and she often channels her magic through your close telepathic bond. You can cast Force Barrage and Translocate as 4th-rank primal innate spells once per day each. For 1 minute after casting either spell, the range of your Limited Telepathy quadruples.

name: Quenching Breath
text: Your breath floods the area with so much water that it instantly quenches normal flames with ease. All non-magical fires within the area of your Dragon Breath are extinguished.

name: Quick Break
text: You learn to prepare your natural weapons much more quickly than before. Breaking off knives from your body loses the manipulate trait and becomes a free action instead of a 1-action activity, and your unarmed attacks are now treated as though they had the advanced weapon improvement.

name: Quick Climb
text: When Climbing, you move 5 more feet on a success and 10 more feet on a critical success, up to your Speed. If you're legendary in Athletics, you gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Quick Coercion
text: You issue threats with frightening speed. You can Coerce a creature in a single round rather than the usual 1 minute.

name: Quick Disguise
text: You can set up a disguise in one-tenth the usual time (generally 1 minute). If you're a master in Deception, you can create a full disguise and Impersonate as a 3-action activity. If you're legendary, it takes a single action.

name: Quick Draw
text: You can draw and attack in a single fluid motion. You can Interact to draw a weapon as a free action at the start of your turn, and drawing a weapon no longer triggers reactions.

name: Quick Identification

meta.Prerequisites: ["trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion"]

text: You identify magic with remarkable speed. You can Identify Magic in 1 minute rather than 10 minutes, and as a 3-action activity when pressed for time.

name: Quick Install
text: You can install augmentations and tech gear faster than most. Reduce the time required to install or uninstall equipment by half.

name: Quick Jump
text: You can jump with a single action. You can High Jump or Long Jump as a single action, though you can't move more than your Speed.
